findings.current: but it was a mark of adulthood.
findings.defect: The source says this was what qualified him as an adult, not merely a sign of adulthood.
findings.rationale: 어른의 자격 means the qualification or grounds for being an adult; “a mark of adulthood” weakens that claim.
findings.replacement: but that was what qualified him as an adult.

findings.current: At thirteen, he’d already shown he could do something even adults who’d merely grown older with the years they’d been given could not.
findings.defect: The assembled sentence omits that Prince Shangshan proved this on his own.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly says 홀로 입증해 보였다 (“proved on his own”); the accepted baseline also preserved this detail.
findings.replacement: At thirteen, Prince Shangshan had already proved on his own that he could do what even adults who’d merely grown older with the years they’d been given could not.

summary: The translation is broadly faithful, with two minor details weakened in the description of Prince Shangshan’s maturity.
